title: DeepSeek V4 Pro Cuts Claude Costs by 97%
description:
DeepSeek V4 Pro performs like Claude Opus but costs 90% less. Anthropic charges $15 per million tokens. DeepSeek charges $1.74. Run the whole thing through claude code with just two environment variables. Point the base URL to DeepSeek's Anthropic endpoint, add your API key, and launch like normal. Same interface, same agent, same file edits. The $200 plan drops to roughly $7. The fastest claude code tutorial for cutting costs with deepseek v4 while keeping full free claude code functionality.

Get the step-by-step setup guide here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1nPlSTIGdec_wvXVS9FuewLMnjLiCT_X1/edit?usp=sharing&ouid=110897400342351178452&rtpof=true&sd=true
